name: smith standing behind head military press
description: A standing overhead press with the smith bar lowered behind the head. It builds the shoulders and triceps and needs good shoulder mobility.
instructions: Set the Smith bar around upper-chest height and stand beneath it with your feet planted.
Unhook the bar with a grip wider than shoulder width, keeping your trunk braced.
Press the bar upward along the fixed rails until it clears your head.
If your shoulder mobility allows, move your head slightly forward and lower the bar behind your head to a comfortable depth.
Press back up, then return the bar to the front and rerack it; stay inside the rails throughout.
